FinanceState.title: FinanceState
FinanceState.description: User personal finance state including accounts, transactions, subscriptions, goals, debts, and payoff simulation preferences

currency.description: Base active currency code (USD, KWD, EUR, GBP, SAR, etc.)

privacyMask.description: Whether financial numbers are obfuscated in UI

accounts.description: Asset and liability bank accounts, credit cards, investments, and cash

transactions.description: Income, expense, and transfer ledger records

subscriptions.description: Recurring subscription billing items and cycles

debts.description: Active debt liabilities with APR, minimum payments, and balances

debtSimulator.description: Debt snowball/avalanche settings and extra payment simulation parameters

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of last cloud state synchronization

/users/{userId}/data/financeState.description: Authenticated user personal financial portfolio and settings store

/guest_sessions/{deviceId}/data/financeS.description: Guest and visitor device session financial data store ensuring all user inputs are persisted to Firestore
